YOUTH GROUP STORMS DPWH HQ OVER ALLEGED FLOOD PROJECT CORRUPTION

WATCH: Members of the militant youth group Anakbayan held a protest outside the DPWH headquarters in Port Area, Manila on Thursday, September 4.

The group denounced alleged corruption in flood control projects and demanded accountability from President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s officials and DPWH executives over what they described as systematic plunder of public funds. | via Jonas Sulit, @DWAR1494
